source_caption:
🎬 Ready Player One (2018)

Ready Player One follows Wade Watts, a teenager living in the year 2045, when much of humanity escapes the struggles of everyday life by entering the OASIS, an enormous virtual reality universe filled with incredible worlds, adventures, and endless possibilities. When the OASIS’s creator dies, he leaves behind a hidden Easter egg that promises complete control of the virtual world and an enormous fortune to whoever discovers it first. Determined to win, Wade joins forces with a group of talented players to solve challenging puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and compete against a powerful corporation seeking to take control of the OASIS. As the competition becomes increasingly dangerous, Wade discovers that friendship, courage, and real-world connections matter more than any virtual reward. Directed by Steven Spielberg, the film delivers spectacular action, nostalgic pop culture references, and an unforgettable science-fiction adventure.

🎭 Genre: Sci-Fi • Action • Adventure

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 20m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Steven Spielberg

✍️ Writers: Zak Penn & Ernest Cline

📚 Based On: Ready Player One by Ernest Cline

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.

source_details.title: Ready Player One
source_details.synopsis: Ready Player One is a 2018 American science fiction action film directed by Steven Spielberg and written by Zak Penn and Ernest Cline. Based on Cline's 2011 novel, the film stars Tye Sheridan, Olivia Cooke, Ben Mendelsohn, Lena Waithe, T.J. Miller, Simon Pegg, and Mark Rylance. The film is set in 2045, where much of humanity uses the OASIS, a virtual reality simulation, to escape the real world. Teenage orphan Wade Watts (Sheridan) finds clues to a contest that promises ownership of the OASIS to the winner, and he and his friends try to complete it before an evil corporation can do so. Development of the film began in mid-2010 when Warner Bros. Entertainment acquired the rights to the book.
